skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Candy Cape
skins.content: Weedy's Stage Outfit/Candy Cape. A vivid and colorful stage costume, pursued with multiple-layered design and modification for full effect, demanding complex fabrication. Dirt- and wear-resistant, as well as excellently dustproofed.
skins.quote: Word is that the musical production had a strange name—'The Nutcracker.'

skins.name: Sedjem
skins.content: Misaligned Sightseer New Arrivals/Sedjem. Weedy treads the boundary between sand and water, tracing the flow ever deeper. Is what she hears the whispers of the sea of salt, or the greetings of the sea of sand?
skins.quote: Weedy goes wherever the wind blows. It seems rather clear she's forgotten she's here on holiday.
